rationale: High-cost claims (top 5%) are rare by definition, creating class imbalance. Using train_only threshold computation prevents test leakage. Feature selection excludes paid_amount (target) and member_oop/cob_amount (post-adjudication outcomes) while including diagnostic, service, and provider characteristics available at claim submission. Preprocessing fit on train only with standard scaling ensures logistic regression and random forest receive properly scaled inputs without data leakage. Random forest provides non-linear complementarity to logistic regression for ranking claims by high-cost risk. Denominators and artifact citations support transparency and reproducibility.
